content.value: Using AISC column specifications, determine the safe axial loads on a $\mathrm { W } 3 6 0 \times 1 2 2$ section used as a column under the following conditions: (i) hinged ends and a length of 9m; (ii) built in ends and an unsupported length of 10 m; (ii) built-in ends and a length of 10m braced at the midpoint. Use $\sigma _ { y p } { = } 3 8 0 \mathrm { M P a }$ and E=200 GPa. (Use Table B-2: Properties of Wide-Flange Section.)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
